newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer rises sharply on 4-mth report.
newsitem.headline: Amer rises sharply on 4-mth report.

text.p: Shares in Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy rose sharply on Thursday after it reported that four-month losses narrowed to 49 million markka from a year-ago loss of 114 million markka, brokers said.

At 1410/1110 GMT Amer traded 3.00 markka or more than three percent higher at 102.00 markka after briefly hitting an intra-day high of 104.00 in relatively lively 16 million markka volume on an otherwise quiet bourse.
The loss was smaller than the median of analysts' forecasts in a Reuters poll at 53 million markka.
